definitions.service_path_candidate: Matched path from bounded service-file scan; may be a file, directory or symlink. It is not a confirmed installed or active service.
definitions.backup_path_candidate: Matched path from a nonrecursive directory scan; may be a script or directory. It is not a validated backup or exhaustive backup inventory.
definitions.configured_agent_entry: Agent ID in the observed client configuration; not proof of a live connection, a distinct account or a credential source.

explicit_preserve.reason: Official comparison oracle; not eligible for legacy cleanup while compatibility work remains.

limitations: The six reports are retained 2026-11-04 observations; this register performs no current host mutations or fresh inventory.
A count of zero matched candidates is not proof of zero installed services, binaries, clients or backups.
